items.title: Kristen Korb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000
items.q: And I was at the west coast jazz party with him two years ago and just to have him just growling at me over that ride cymbal

ctx.x: Who’s on your wish list to play with?

Kenny Barron, Russell Malone and Jeff Hamilton are my top three right now. That’s my goal in the next three to five years. Actually one to three years. I want to play with those guys. I want to be in those bands. And then beyond that, you know, of course, everyone — I think I would really like to be in New York. I’m feeling this urge to be there. I’ve just got to figure out how to get myself there. Because one of the things — that I’ve been taking care of my own business, I know that the scene there is marvelous.…
Yeah, there’s an energy there for sure.
